title: First Amendment to the Regulation on Institutions Providing Custodial Services
text:
Unofficial English Translation
Capital Market Development Authority (CMDA)
First Amendment to the Regulation on Institutions Providing Custodial Services
Regulation
Regulation Number: 2021/R-68
(Unofficial Translation)
The following amendments are to be brought to the Regulation on Institutions providing Custodial
Services Regulation (Regulation Number: 2011/R-36).
1. Section 5 of the Regulation to be amended as follows;
5. Providing custodial services without the necessary license or insinuating to the
public or clientele that you are a "custodian" constitutes an offense. Those found in
violation of this provision are subject to a fine between MVR.75,000 (seventy-five
thousand) and MVR.150,000 (one hundred and fifty thousand).
2. Section 8 of the Regulation to be amended as follows;
8. Each custodian shall pay an annual fee to the Authority as follows.
(a) The Annual Fee for Licensees providing Custodial Services is MVR
120,000 (One hundred and Twenty Thousand).
(b) The annual fee for custodial licensees who have not provided custodian
services is MVR 10,000 (Ten Thousand).
3. The opening phrase of Section 60 of the Regulation to be amended as follows:
60. Custodial service providers shall submit the following documents to the
Authority every year.
4. This regulation will come into effect on the date the regulation is published in the Gazette.
